NOTES.md: appended a dated fix note to the 2026-08-11 section documenting that data.json now carries the verified semantics (verified/verification_notes/last_refreshed).

summary: Encoded the NOTES.md 2026-08-11 verified statement into data.json by adding top-level verified:false, verification_notes (true for public-source process/status facts; false for capacity/permit-finality/energization), and last_refreshed 2026-08-11, mirroring refreshed sibling convention.
